name: Week 32 Legs — Squat Holds, RDL Goes 45 · 70 · 70
description: Same legs session with one small step: W31's 70 RDL set felt clean and left more available, so W32 runs 45 · 70 · 70. Squat holds 80/side, leg curl holds the newly settled 70, and the hip-machine loads stay put. The warmup rotates hip circles to easy glute bridges.

dayOverview.theme: Familiar legs day. Add one 70/side RDL set, keep the squat and machines stable, and rotate one warmup move.

spotlights.why: You solved last week's side-recruitment question yourself by pacing the left rather than forcing it. That fix becomes the instruction this week, and the cue it protects — hip flat and square — is the one worth drilling.

Three weeks of this slot being decided by whatever the machine was doing: a mismatch, then a self-found 250, then broken. It gets deliberate cues and a fallback, so the work stops depending on the equipment.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W33 can restore a longer accessory if the week opens up; W32 remains the short template.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: squat, barbell RDL, leg press, kneeling leg curl, hip abduction, hip adduction. Effort means the cue holding at a hard load; the ceiling is the rep the cue breaks.
🔥 near-failure last set OK: leg press calf raise. Isolation work where form holds at the limit.
**RDL: 45 · 70 · 70.** W31's lone 70 set stayed clean. Stop either 70 set when grip or hinge form becomes the limiter; do not grind.
**Never judge the squat on set 1.** It earned this caveat over three weeks; one clean week does not unearn it. Set 1 is information, not a verdict.
**The heel plates stay at 45 in the warmup.** They finally bought real depth there. Heels-up at 80 comes back when the 45 version is boring — one good week is not boring yet.
**Stance is settled — do not test it.** The current wide V beats feet-forward and beats going wider. That question is closed.
**Leg curl holds 70.** W31 ran all three sets without the between-rep pause; left goes first and still sets the clean count.
**If the abduction machine is still broken, the fallback is written into the block.** A dead machine means take the fallback, not skip the slot.
**No straps on the RDL, and no flipped hand.** Double-overhand at every weight including the 70.

sets.name: Legs Warmup — Ankle First, Then the Heel-Elevated Ramp
sets.notes: The ankle work leads because the ankle is the confirmed limiter. **The heel plates live here, at 45** — that is where they finally taught something instead of turning the lift into a different exercise.

exercises.notes: Slow up, slow down — feel the shin.
Toe to wall, knee bent, heel glued down. **Still no measurement** — the baseline is banked at right 1.5 fists, left 1 fist, and the re-measure is a few weeks out.
Light band, eversion only — slow and controlled. The left one is the point.
30s each side. Eyes open, hands on hips. Let the ankle do the correcting.
Your usual stance — the wide V, no experiments. Heels down, chest up, knees out. Note where depth stops today.
Easy reps, ribs down and a brief glute squeeze at the top. Warm up; do not fatigue.
**The brace, woken deliberately.** It is half the answer to the depth question — bring it online before the bar.

**LOAD:** 45/side, two rounds.

**Round 1 — flat, 5 reps, 2-3s pause in the bottom.** The standard you already set.

**Round 2 — 5lb plate under each heel, 5 reps, 2-3s pause.**
- **Use the extra room** — with the heels up there is more of it, and the point is to go there
- **Stay upright and let the knees travel forward** — that is what the elevation buys
- **Hold the brace through the pause**, ribs down
- Last week this read as real depth for the first time. See whether it repeats before it gets promoted anywhere.

sets.name: Squat — 80/side, All Three Flat 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 80/side, 3 working sets of 6-8. **All flat — the plates stay in the warmup.**

Last week all three sets read the same: "fully in control and fairly deep and controlled every set." That is the first week the set-1 caveat went unused twice running — it still stays in the notes one more week, because it was earned over three weeks and one clean week does not unearn it.

- **Belt-tight brace** — ribs down, glutes and core braced, shoulders packed down
- **Depth is the descent** — find where power falls off in the hole and work into it, not past it
- **The pelvis tucking under is the floor.** Stop just above where it starts; that edge is what moves over months
- 80 has read like what 45 used to read like for three weeks now. That is the floor rising and it needs nothing done to it

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 80/side, 3 sets, all flat.
- Usual wide V stance, no experiments
- Belt-tight brace, ribs down, shoulders packed down
- Depth is the job, not the load
- Stop just above where the pelvis starts to tuck

sets.name: Barbell RDL — 45 · 70 · 70, Two Clean Working Sets 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 45/side · 70/side · 70/side, 3 sets of 8-10, straight after the squat. W31's lone 70 set felt clean and left more available; this adds one repeat, not a new top weight.

- Double-overhand, no straps or flipped hand
- Soft knees, hips back, bar brushing the thighs
- 3s down; stop where the hamstrings or grip stop you
- No grinding or leaning back at the top

**Reflection:** what ended the second 70 set — hamstrings, hands, or neither?

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 45/side · 70/side · 70/side.
- Double-overhand; no straps or flipped hand
- Bar low in the fingers, squeeze before you lift
- Soft knees, hips back, bar brushing the thighs
- 3s eccentric; stop when hamstrings, grip or position ends the set

sets.name: 🔆 Kneeling Leg Curl — 70, Left Side First 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 70, 3 sets of 10-12 each side. Left first; match the right to the left's clean count. W31 ran all three sets at 70 without needing the pause between reps.

- Only the lower leg moves
- Hips stay flat and square
- Slow eccentric
- Log both sides separately

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 70.
- Left side first and it sets the count
- Only the lower leg moves; hips flat and square
- Slow eccentric
- When the front of the hip joins in, the set is done
- Log both sides separately

sets.name: Leg Press — 4 Plates/Side, Knees to Chest 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side, 4 sets of 12.

Ran to the written prescription last week without comment, which at this point is what this lift does. Depth is the standing job.

- **Deep ROM — work depth, not weight**
- **Ribs down, no leaning back**
- **The end-range stretch deep in the hips is the position, not a problem** — the spine is unloaded here, which is why this is a safe place to live at end range
- **Do not read this depth as permission at 80 on the bar** — they are different problems
- Slow into the bottom, no bouncing out of it

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side, 4 sets.
- **Deep ROM** — depth, not weight
- Ribs down, no leaning back
- Knees to chest is the standard
- Slow into the bottom, no bouncing out of it

sets.name: Leg Press Calf Raise — 4 Plates/Side 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side, 3 sets of 15. **Same machine — stay where you are.**

- Balls of the feet on the bottom platform edge, heels off
- **Full controlled heel drop** — the slow stretch is the stimulus
- Press through the forefoot to a full contraction
- Knees stay soft and still
- Last set can run near failure

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side.
- Full controlled heel drop
- Press through the forefoot
- Knees soft and still

sets.name: 🔆 Hip Abduction — 250, Two Sets, 2s Fully Open 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 250, 2 sets of 12-15. W31's pause landed in the middle and a third set was added. This week keep exactly two sets and hold 2 seconds with the legs fully open — the hard end of the range.

- Slow out, hold 2s fully open, slow back
- Torso quiet; no rocking
- If the machine is unavailable, use both written mat fallbacks for two sets each

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 250. Two sets only.
- Slow out
- **Hold 2 seconds with the legs fully open**
- Slow back; torso quiet, no rocking

**FALLBACK — only if the machine is dead.** Side-lying, knees bent and stacked, feet together.
- **Open the top knee slowly and hold a beat at the top**
- **The top hip must not roll backwards** — that roll is how the work escapes to the front of the hip
- Add a light band above the knees if one is around

**FALLBACK — pairs with the clamshell.** Same side-lying setup, top leg straight.
- **Lift from the side of the hip, not the front** — lead with the heel a touch, toes pointing forward, not up
- Slow up, **slower down**
- Hips stacked and still; if the torso rocks back, the range is too big

sets.name: Hip Adduction Machine — 300 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 300, 2 sets of 12-15.

Skipped last week to a long line rather than a breakdown, so the number stands untouched.

- **Tempo is the only lever**
- Slow release out to a full stretch — the adductors are the tissue that capped the wide-stance test, so the stretch end matters here
- Torso still, no rocking

**If there is a line again, take the cossack squats below instead** — same tissue, no machine, and you already know the movement from the morning flow.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 300.
- **Tempo is the only lever**
- Slow release to a full stretch
- Torso still

**FALLBACK — only if the machine is occupied.** Slow, deep, heel down on the bent side.
- **Sit into one hip and let the other leg straighten fully** — the straight leg's inner thigh is the target
- Toes of the straight leg can turn up; keep the chest tall
- Hold a beat at the bottom of each rep

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block
sets.notes: Five minutes, every gym day. Slow breathing throughout — the downshift is as much the point as the tissue.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress.
30s each side.
45s each side.
Slow breathing. End here.

tips: RDL is 45 · 70 · 70. Report what ends the second 70 set: hamstrings, hands, or neither.
Leg curl stays at 70. Left first, hip square, slow eccentric.
Heel plates stay at 45 in the warmup. Not under the working sets.
If the abduction machine is dead, take the clamshell and side-lying lift — don't skip the slot.
Log the leg curl's two sides separately.
